title: limonium sommierianum
intro: Limonium sommierianum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a succulent flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender include calming the nervous system, reducing stress and promoting relaxation, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as linalool and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
